svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · TOKENIZER VOCAB SIZING & FUSED CROSS-ENTROPY (#373)
152K Multilingual BPE Fertility vs. 39.8 GB Logits HBM Explosion (Liger / CCE)
152K Vocab speeds up Chinese/Code serving by 2.23x, while Fused Linear Cross-Entropy cuts Logits HBM from 39.8 GB to 0.12 GB
• 152K BPE cuts 10k Chinese chars from 14,500 to 6,500 tokens
FP32 logits (19.9 GB) + backward dLogits (19.9 GB) in HBM
• Consumes 39.8 GB HBM on Every GPU Just for the Final Loss!
Tier 4: 152K Vocab + Liger / Apple Cut Cross-Entropy
• Never materializes the full [B*S, V] logits tensor in GPU HBM!
• Computes chunked LM_Head MatMul + Online LogSumExp + Grad
on-the-fly inside SRAM/small tiles (works at TP=1 FSDP2!)
• 0.12 GB Logits HBM (331x less) + 2.23x Faster Chinese/Code Serving
4-Tier Tokenizer Vocab & LM-Head Loss Matrix (10k zh-CN Chars · 32K Training Tokens/GPU)
Tier 1 (32K BPE + Naive Loss) : 10k Chars = 14,500 Tok | Speed = 1.00x | Logits HBM = 8.40 GB
Tier 2 (152K BPE + Naive FP32 Loss) : 10k Chars = 6,500 Tok | Speed = 2.23x | Logits HBM = 39.80 GB (OOM!)
Tier 3 (152K BPE + Vocab-Parallel) : 10k Chars = 6,500 Tok | Speed = 2.23x | Logits HBM = 5.00 GB (TP=8)
Tier 4 (152K BPE + Liger/Apple CCE) : 10k Chars = 6,500 Tok | Speed = 2.23x | Logits HBM = 0.12 GB (TP=1 OK)
